ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-to-mid intensity (dark grey) ventral surface with high-intensity (white) linear and punctate clusters; estimated 3:1 ratio of dark pixels to light pixels within the fluke boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) punctate clusters are concentrated near the median notch and distal tips. Linear light-colored striations cross the mid-lobes. Contiguous dark-intensity regions are localized along the proximal leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the trailing edge; distal tips exhibit increased pixel-amplitude 'jaggedness' compared to the mid-lobe regions.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, high-contrast linear marks (rake-like scratches) distributed across the entire ventral surface, with high density on the right lobe (pixel-right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Rough, irregular topographical clusters at the distal tips suggesting significant surface colonization or healed trauma.
